info.title: Thapsus-HR API
info.description: Versioned public REST API. All responses are served from the tenant's home region and are never cached at the edge.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

get.summary: Begin SSO sign-in (redirects to the identity provider)

post.summary: Create a workspace in this region (the caller has already chosen the home region)

get.summary: List or export the audit log (JSON page or full CSV/JSON download for a date range)
List employees the caller may see (cursor-paginated, permission-filtered)

post.summary: Hire (create) an employee with effective-dated personal, job, pay and contract records
Apply an effective-dated change (past, today or future-dated)

put.summary: Replace the emergency contact list in force from a date (default today); later future-dated lists are kept

get.summary: Export the people list (same filters and scope as GET /v1/employees); unreadable fields are blank per row
Export my task list (same rows as GET /v1/tasks)
Export approval requests (same rows as GET /v1/approvals); changed fields are listed by name, never their values
Export the documents list (same folder permissions as GET /v1/documents)

post.summary: Give a person a sign-in (employee self-service, optionally manager) and email them a one-time invitation link

get.summary: My onboarding: documents to sign, forms to complete and checklist tasks (works before the start date)

servers.description: Your workspace home region (uk, eu or us). Responses are never cached at the edge.
